items.title: Can You Trust Your Finance Agent? Drift, Diagnosis and Auditable Intervention on One Shipped Financial Research Agent
items.claim: Untuned finance agent run-to-run drift means cost optimization saves money while held-out accuracy gains fall inside measurement noise.

items.title: Evidence-Gated Self-Improvement in a Production Crypto Swing-Trading System: Rule Gates, Gradient Boosting, and an LLM Council
items.claim: Production crypto LLM gates reject most candidate models, leaving live per-trade edge far below headline backtests.

items.title: Remembered Markets: LLM Memorisation of US and Indian Stock Prices
items.claim: Backtests using LLM-recalled prices earn double-digit annual returns because models memorize pre-cutoff market moves.

items.title: When Does Brier-Reward RL Help a Small Language Model Forecast? Controlled Experiments on Kalshi Economic Markets
items.claim: Small language model Brier-reward RL improves forecasting only when group standard-deviation scaling is switched off.

items.title: Quality Uncertainty, Calibration Inversion, and Transaction-Cost Governance Boundaries in Autonomous Agentic Forecasting Markets
items.claim: Flat-fee LLM forecasts in prediction markets lose to a free base-rate benchmark as verbalized confidence inverts with accuracy.

items.title: TradeGauntlet: Evaluating Compliance Controls for Autonomous Trading Agents
items.claim: Compliance gates that block self-crossing orders cut agent fill rates without proving the agent follows broader trading rules.
